controls: Get explicit approval before any billable request.
Approval of first pass does not authorize remaining hard-cap balance.
Check current quoted charge including taxes/fees before submission; if unavailable or uncertain stop.
Maintain spent plus reserved in-flight cost; never exceed approved limit or $10 total including any taxes/fees.
Sequential requests, one output per request. No automatic retries, paid upgrades, audio or upscaling.
If a request times out, reconcile status and billing before another request; never blindly resubmit.
No account top-up or purchase exceeding remaining total cap. If provider requires a larger minimum deposit, stop and report.
Wan endpoint lists retirement on January 4, 2027. Recheck availability; no automatic model substitution.
